select m.id, m.season_id, se.display_title as season_title, m.division_id, d.division_name, m.platform_code, m.schedule_batch_id, m.round_no, m.match_no, m.stage_id, m.series_id, m.series_game_no, ms.series_code, ms.best_of, m.match_time, m.home_event_team_id, ht.team_name_snapshot as home_team_name, m.away_event_team_id, at.team_name_snapshot as away_team_name, m.home_score, m.away_score, m.winner_event_team_id, m.match_status, m.publish_status, m.venue_text, m.remark, m.replay_url from basket_match m left join basket_season se on se.id = m.season_id and se.is_delete = 0 left join basket_division d on d.id = m.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 left join basket_event_team ht on ht.id = m.home_event_team_id and ht.is_delete = 0 left join basket_event_team at on at.id = m.away_event_team_id and at.is_delete = 0 left join basket_match_series ms on ms.id = m.series_id and ms.is_delete = 0 where m.is_delete = 0

stage_id = #{stageId}, group_id = #{groupId}, bracket_slot = #{bracketSlot}, match_time = #{matchTime}, venue_text = #{venueText}, remark = #{remark}, replay_url = #{replayUrl}, home_score = #{homeScore}, away_score = #{awayScore}, home_event_team_id = #{homeEventTeamId}, away_event_team_id = #{awayEventTeamId}, winner_event_team_id = #{winnerEventTeamId}, source_match_id_home = #{sourceMatchIdHome}, source_match_id_away = #{sourceMatchIdAway}, loser_event_team_id = #{loserEventTeamId}, match_status = #{matchStatus}, publish_status = #{publishStatus}, update_time = now()

update basket_match set is_delete = 1, match_no = concat(match_no, '#', id), series_game_no = CASE WHEN series_id IS NOT NULL THEN id ELSE series_game_no END, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
